payload.test_method: The journal records that the model tests and plugin validation passed, and that all 21 plugin bindings were present before and after a live Hyprland reload with no configuration errors.
payload.expected_result: All 21 plugin-provided keypad bindings return after a Hyprland configuration reload.
payload.actual_result: All 21 bindings were reported before and after the live reload, and the compositor reported no configuration errors.
payload.limitations: This is one private journal import from one account and one system, not an independent firsthand confirmation. The historical Omarchy, shell, compositor, and hardware versions were not recorded. A later read-only check found plugin version 0.1.1 and 21 live keypad bindings but deliberately did not repeat a reload.
payload.provenance: Imported from the user's private system-change journal; no raw logs or private journal text are attached.
payload.adverse_effects: No adverse effect was recorded in the journal's reload test. The plugin remains unsandboxed custom code and continuously probes compositor state.

activation.details: The journal records one shell restart to replace the cached service instance; a later read-only local check found the plugin installed, enabled, and its 21 keypad bindings present.

root_cause.rationale: The journal ties the failure to dynamically registered bindings being cleared by a compositor reload while the shell service remained loaded, and the successful intervention specifically detects and restores the absent sentinel binding.
